description: This file contains assembly routines for thread context switching and service call handling on ARM Cortex-A and Cortex-R CPUs within the Zephyr RTOS. It includes functions for saving/restoring thread state, handling system calls, and managing CPU exceptions.

methods.name: z_arm_context_switch
methods.description: Performs a context switch between two threads, saving and restoring CPU state, thread-specific data, and handling optional thread-local storage and MPU configuration.

methods.name: z_arm_svc
methods.description: Handles system calls (svc) for context switching, IRQ offloading, and kernel exceptions, including nested exception handling and switching to IRQ mode.
